newsitem.title: FINLAND: Merita probes year-highs, boosts lively Helsinki.
newsitem.headline: Merita probes year-highs, boosts lively Helsinki.

text.p: Shares on Tuesday were boosted by a continued rally in banking group Merita Oy and the HEX general index set a new intra-day year-high as index-heavy Nokia briefly managed to rise above Monday close, brokers said.
The HEX index closed up 0.54 percent at 2,219.9 with volume a solid 530 million markka. Merita topped the volume table at around 130 million markka.

Nokia responded calmly to weak third-quarter results from U.S. rival Motorola, which brokers said were in line with forecasts. The Finnish firm closed 0.30 lower at 210.70, but held clearly above its 207.63 equivalent Monday U.S. close.
Motorola and Nokia both ticked up in early U.S. dealings.

Demand for Merita has been lively, especially from overseas since CEO Vesa Vainio's road show in the U.S. last week: the steep positive trend continued. Merita hit 13.00 markka, a peak since October 2 1995 and closed at a 12.80 year-high.
Amer rose sharply, up 5.00 markka to 107.00, "on purely speculative trade" ahead of its January-August result due on Thursday, one broker said.

Finnlines rose 3.40 markka to a 100.50 markka 22-month high on hopes it could gain from cooperation with Swedish Bilspedition and from rising imports to Finland. Many brokerages also recently issued buy recommendations on the stock.
Forestries were mixed ahead of results next week, as brokers said investors await new information about the sector's recovery.
